Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Jurupa Valley for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 2 of them free. The season brings the Jurupa Valley Tree Lighting Celebration (December 4), the JARPD Breakfast with Santa (December 12), the Santa Claws Workshop at Jurupa Mountains Discovery Center (December 19) and Eastvale's Miracle on Citrus Street with a North Pole train and real snow (December 19 and 20). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Jurupa Valley

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Jurupa Valley, Mira Loma and Eastvale
  • 2 free events, including the Tree Lighting Celebration and Miracle on Citrus Street
  • Meet Santa: the tree lighting (December 4), JARPD Breakfast with Santa (December 12) and the Santa Claws Workshop (December 19)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Jurupa Valley Tree Lighting Celebration (December 4)
  • Trains and snow: Miracle on Citrus Street in Eastvale with the North Pole Express and a snow field (December 19 and 20)
  • Season: December 4 to December 20

Planning a bigger day out? Jurupa Valley families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Riverside, which covers the Mission Inn Festival of Lights, Riverside's Nutcracker and Breakfast with Santa at city parks.
